added_lines: november intentions please remember that during november, all weekday intentions are for the november dead list and no single intentions will be taken. this means the weekend masses will be busy so please try to get anniversary dates booked soon to avoid disappointment. the annual november dead mass will be held on friday 13th november. families who lost a loved one in the last 12 months will receive a letter of invite to the mass. all family members are welcome. thank you. st oliver plunkett

we would like to say thank you to the net ministry team who have been with us since 12th october. each day of our mission was very different and their presence left a very positive mark on our parish, the primary and secondary schools they visited, and on ourselves personally. we thank our incredible speakers—the feedback has been amazing we appreciate their time to join our parish mission. we also wish to thank all our parishioners who took part by attending or watching on the webcam. if you missed some days and wish to view, they are recorded on our website for you. an finally, we thank our host families who accepted the young people into their homes for the duration of the mission. diocese of down & connor we are seeking to recruit into the role of “assistant housekeeper ” for the bishop’s residence and curia office at somerton road, belfast. please visit our news page on our website for full details of the post. vacancy - assistant housekeeper | st. oliver plunkett parish so back to that time of year! we have sourced many great prizes this year again for our christmas ballot. tickets will again be £5 each and we should have them very soon. we have even secured a holiday this year! please support if you can. thank you. christmas shoe boxes are available from both porches. please, only take the number of boxes you can realistically fill. thank you in ad- vance for supporting this project every year. lets make it the best year yet! diocese of down & connor an opportunity has arisen for a sacristan/caretaker for hannahstown parish belfast. 16 hours per week. closing date is 12 noon on thursday 29th october. please visit the news page on our website for full details of the post or visit the job vacancies page on:

important! this coming week starting monday 19th october, there will 10am mass on monday morning as usual but no weekday mass for the rest of the week. thank you. day trip to knock monday 2nd november for the feast of all souls - leaving st agnes’ at 7.30am £30 per person includes tea and scone contact harriet
